---
title: "3. Intensities & signal-to-noise"
params:
  run_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setup.R", local = TRUE)
```

## Median intensities

Median log2 intensity of the methylated versus the unmethylated channel per sample, before any correction. Samples below the dashed threshold (`r cfg$intensity_threshold`) in either channel are removed.

```{r, results="asis"}
p <- prepDNAm::qc_plot_intensities(rd)
if (is.null(p)) not_available("Intensity data")
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
interactive_plot(p, height = 600)
```

## Failed probes per sample

Fraction of probes with detection p-value above `r cfg$detp_threshold` (log scale); samples above the dashed line (`r cfg$failed_probe_threshold`) are removed.

```{r, results="asis"}
p <- prepDNAm::qc_plot_failed_probes(rd)
if (is.null(p)) not_available("Detection p-values")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
interactive_plot(p, height = 420)
```

## Signal-to-noise

Estimated signal-to-noise ratio (rho) per sample, from the positions of the unmethylated and methylated peaks of the raw type II beta distribution (see `?rhoEstimator`). Low values indicate compressed beta distributions, e.g. from degraded or low-input DNA; the metric can be useful for exploring storage effects in biobanked samples and is cell-type dependent.

```{r, results="asis"}
p <- prepDNAm::qc_plot_rho(rd)
if (is.null(p)) not_available("Signal-to-noise data")
```

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
interactive_plot(p, height = 420)
```
